t: The Glomma Straight Grab Rail is a robust mobility aid designed to provide support in various household settings. Ideal for bathrooms, kitchens, or hallways, it assists with everyday movements such as pulling, pushing, and maintaining balance. Constructed from stainless steel, this chrome 450mm grab bar offers excellent corrosion resistance and is easy to clean, ensuring long-lasting performance. Its versatile design allows for horizontal, vertical, or diagonal mounting, adapting to specific user needs. Concealed fixings provide a neat and professional finish, and all necessary fixings are supplied for straightforward installation. This durable grab rail supports up to 100kg when fitted to a solid wall.
b: Max. 100kg Load When Fitted to a Solid Wall
